tools.name: get_song
tools.description:
Details for one GrooveSheet song: every part and what notation it has.

Each part is `sheet_music` (readable score, PDF, Guitar Pro), `midi_only`
(MIDI transcription, no score) or `audio_only` (isolated stem). Includes the
song page URL and, for each scored part, its sheet music page.
